group_results.reason: Let B be a valid .lzma stream using a 4096-byte dictionary, and supply B followed by B. The helper initially presents the first B. Alone header parsing initializes LZMA1EXT; its first dictionary allocation has size zero, so it executes the added assignment.

build.reason: The recipe builds static liblzma, copies its archive to the path used by the complete fuzz-target Makefile, and that Makefile compiles and links fuzz_decode_alone.

input.reason: The helper supplies generated bytes to lzma_code in chunks. Its initial half can contain a complete valid .lzma stream when the supplied input is B followed by B.

lifecycle.reason: Each invocation initializes a fresh stream, initializes the Alone decoder before coding, and ends the stream afterward. Initialization failure invokes cleanup.

control_flow.reason: The entry initializes Alone decoding; lzma_code dispatches to alone_decode. Its accepted header selects LZMA1EXT, and that initializer calls lzma_lz_decoder_init before payload decoding.
